text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambia press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An air-blast rocks Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines' Mufulira underground mine and surrounding areas forcing management to suspend operations.
- Cargo trains come to a standstill while passenger trains operate on a skeleton staff as a strike by Zambia Railways employees spreads.
- Japan comes out in full support of Zambia's political and economic record and says the country deserves renewed aid from donors.

- Opposition parties say they secretly conducted a DNA test on president Frederick Chiluba and will present the results in the supreme court as evidence to prove that the president is the sone of Chabala Kafupi, a Zairean. The court refused to order the president to undergo a DNA test.
